positions.name: RehearsalAsConstitutiveOfReadiness
positions.frame: does a capability that has not been rehearsed count as a capability the organization actually has, and does a recurring cadence enact that standard?
positions.why: src-1 sets the monthly cadence as a settled operational rule ('from now on'), src-2 supplies the aphoristic equivalence that an unrehearsed rollback is one the organization does not actually have, and src-3 formalizes that same cadence in the memo's structured Cadence field — three expressions performing the same directional move: readiness is defined by rehearsal, not merely preceded by it, and the cadence is the mechanism that keeps that definition satisfied.
